text: Because it lacks anticipatory rulemaking capability, the existing regulatory system addresses issues only ex post, and only once they have materialized and burdened core constituents enough to generate political pressure on lawmakers.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2740477

isBasedOn.name: Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation

abstract: Because it lacks anticipatory rulemaking capabilities, the existing regulatory system addresses regulatory issues only ex-post, if and when they materialize and if core constituents are sufficiently burdened to precipitate enough political pressure for lawmakers to act.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: issues must materialize and burden core constituents before action
